name: asking
description: Connect AI assistants to Asking: read conversations, contacts and reports, and reply with scoped consent.

interface.longDescription:
Run customer support with Asking, the shared inbox for your team, directly from ChatGPT and Codex. Requires an Asking account.

This plugin connects your Asking workspace to your AI assistant so you can work on customer conversations without switching apps:

- Search conversations, messages, contacts, and Help Center articles in one place.
- Read a conversation with its full message history and contact details.
- Draft replies for review, add private notes, and update status, priority, labels, and assignee.
- Create and update Help Center articles.
- Check report metrics for your account.

It is designed for support and customer success teams that use Asking and want help triaging, summarizing, and answering customer conversations.

Permissions and safety: every request runs with the permissions of the connected user. Read tools are available immediately; drafting, updating, and sending require the scopes you approve during connection. Sending a reply or starting a new conversation delivers a real message to the customer and requires the explicit send scope, which you can grant or revoke at any time.

Limitations: the plugin cannot delete data, does not run bulk operations, and only sees the Asking account that authorized the connection.
capabilities: Search conversations, messages, contacts, and articles
Read conversation history and contact details
Add private notes and update conversations
Create and update Help Center articles
defaultPrompt: Show me the support conversations that are still open.
Summarize the most recent customer conversation.
Draft a reply to the latest conversation, but do not send it.

positive.prompt: Show me the support conversations that are still open.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open conversations from the connected Asking account with contact, status, and last activity.

positive.prompt: Summarize the most recent customer conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the latest conversation's customer, issue, and current status using its message history.

positive.description: Save a draft reply without sending
positive.prompt: Write a draft reply to the most recent conversation telling the customer we are checking on it. Do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms a draft was saved on the conversation and that nothing was sent to the customer.

positive.prompt: How did our support metrics look this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns account summary metrics for the default range, such as created and resolved conversation counts.

positive.description: Look up the contact behind a conversation
positive.prompt: Who is the customer in the most recent conversation? Show their contact details.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the contact's name, email, and recent conversation history from the connected account.

negative.description: Deletion is not supported: the plugin exposes no delete tools, so it should decline and explain that conversations cannot be deleted through it.
negative.prompt: Delete every conversation from last month.

negative.description: Access is scoped to the connected account, so it should explain that it cannot read another company's data.
negative.prompt: Show me the conversations from a different company's account.

negative.description: Bulk messaging is not supported: it should explain that it can only message one existing conversation at a time and ask which customer to contact.
negative.prompt: Send this announcement to all of our customers at once.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search and read conversations, contacts, and Help Center articles; draft and send replies; add private notes; update conversation status, priority, labels, and assignee; manage articles; and view report metrics — all scoped through OAuth consent.

pt-BR.subtitle: Suporte com assistentes de IA
pt-BR.description:
Atenda seus clientes com o Asking, a caixa de entrada compartilhada do seu time, direto do ChatGPT e do Codex. Requer uma conta Asking.

Este plugin conecta o seu espaço de trabalho do Asking ao seu assistente de IA para você trabalhar nas conversas dos clientes sem trocar de app:

- Busque conversas, mensagens, contatos e artigos da Central de Ajuda em um só lugar.
- Leia uma conversa com o histórico completo e os dados do contato.
- Rascunhe respostas para revisão, adicione notas privadas e atualize status, prioridade, etiquetas e responsável.
- Crie e atualize artigos da Central de Ajuda.
- Consulte as métricas dos relatórios da sua conta.

Feito para times de suporte e sucesso do cliente que usam o Asking e querem ajuda para triar, resumir e responder conversas.

Permissões e segurança: cada pedido roda com as permissões do usuário conectado. As ferramentas de leitura ficam disponíveis na hora; rascunhar, atualizar e enviar exigem os escopos que você aprova na conexão. Enviar uma resposta ou iniciar uma nova conversa entrega uma mensagem real ao cliente e exige o escopo de envio, que você pode conceder ou revogar a qualquer momento.

Limitações: o plugin não exclui dados, não faz operações em massa e só enxerga a conta Asking que autorizou a conexão.
